_comment: Ford Mode 22 (enhanced) PIDs for the dashboard. ALL ENTRIES ARE UNVERIFIED community values (Torque Pro / UltraGauge forum posts for 2011-2017 F-150 6R80). Edit Data\pids\ford-enhanced-pids.json to fix them: value = (raw * scale) + offset, raw = big-endian 'bytes' after 62 DID DID (two's complement if signed). 'map' turns a raw integer into a label. Read-only service 22 only.

pids.name: Transmission gear (GEAR_OSC)
pids.source: f150ecoboost.net 'custom PIDs for Torque' (221E12, equation A); raw-to-gear mapping is a guess, 10R80 values unknown
